intent_record.intent_summary: Complete missing SME context restoration support by allocating SME state and setting appropriate thread flags when restoring SVE/SME contexts.
intent_record.what: Added conditional SME (Scalable Matrix Extension) state allocation and thread flag management in restore_sve_fpsimd_context(). When sm parameter is true, allocates SME state, sets SVCR_SM_MASK and TIF_SME flag; otherwise clears SM mask and sets TIF_SVE flag. Also sets fp_type to FP_STATE_SVE.
intent_record.how: Enables proper context restoration for processes using SME extensions alongside SVE. Ensures correct thread state flags are set based on whether SME or SVE-only context is being restored, preventing incorrect state tracking and enabling SME-specific operations after context restore.
